reasons: Both answers catch the 12.3G vs 50G discrepancy, name deleted-but-open files as the prime suspect with correct lsof +L1 and /proc fd commands, explain restart or truncate via /proc/<PID>/fd/<N>, and cover hidden-under-mountpoint files with a bind-mount check.
